summary: Iteration 18 - Frontend testing for TarotOuiNon paywall (1 free tirage/day reset + 4.99€ paywall) and TirageTarot synthese paywall (4.99€). All features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: TarotOuiNon: Counter shows '1 tirage gratuit aujourd'hui' on fresh visit
TarotOuiNon: Tirage button (data-testid='tirage-btn') is visible and clickable
TarotOuiNon: First free tirage works - card result displayed with orientation badge
TarotOuiNon: Counter updates to 'Tirage gratuit utilisé — 4,99€ par tirage supplémentaire' after first tirage
TarotOuiNon: Second tirage attempt shows paywall form (data-testid='paywall-form')
TarotOuiNon: Paywall shows 'Continuez vos tirages' header
TarotOuiNon: Buy button shows 'Obtenir mon tirage — 4,99 €' (data-testid='buy-tirage-btn')
TirageTarot: Marseille option shows '3 cartes • Passé, Présent, Futur' with 19€ price
TirageTarot: Celtique option shows '10 cartes • Analyse complète' with 29€ price
TirageTarot: Cards reveal animation works correctly
TirageTarot: Step 3 shows synthese paywall (data-testid='synthese-paywall') at 4,99€
TirageTarot: Clicking unlock button reveals full synthese content (Tendance Générale, Passé/Présent/Futur messages, Conseil des Arcanes)
Backend: GET /api/tarot/jour returns 200 with valid tirage data (non-regression)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified the new paywall features: 1) TarotOuiNon now limits to 1 free tirage per day with daily reset (localStorage keys: STORAGE_KEY, STORAGE_DATE_KEY), paywall at 4.99€ for additional tirages. 2) TirageTarot keeps card display but hides synthese behind a 4.99€ paywall with 'Voir la synthèse' button (data-testid='btn-unlock-synthese'). Payment is MOCKED - clicking unlock button directly reveals content without actual payment processing.

mocked_features.payment_processing: Both TarotOuiNon 'Obtenir mon tirage' and TirageTarot 'Voir la synthèse' buttons are MOCKED - clicking them reveals content without actual payment. Real Stripe/payment integration would be needed for production.
